notes: Omnath, Locus of the Roil, printed: 'it deals damage to any target equal to the number of Elementals you control.' The number is counted as the ability resolves. Omnath enters with two other Elementals (three) and its trigger targets the opponent; in response one of my Elementals leaves the battlefield, so at resolution I control two (Omnath and the other): 2 damage, the opponent goes from 20 to 18.
